raw.query: WITH per_model AS (SELECT variate, resolution, mode, model, MIN(wape) AS wape FROM provenance.forecast_metrics WHERE model IN ('chronos','timesfm','toto') GROUP BY variate, resolution, mode, model), ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY variate, resolution, mode ORDER BY wape, model) AS rn, MAX(wape) OVER (PARTITION BY variate, resolution, mode) - MIN(wape) OVER (PARTITION BY variate, resolution, mode) AS spread FROM per_model), groups AS (SELECT variate, resolution, mode, MAX(spread) AS spread, MAX(wape) FILTER (WHERE rn=2) - MAX(wape) FILTER (WHERE rn=1) AS win_margin FROM ranked GROUP BY variate, resolution, mode) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_groups, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE spread<0.02) AS n_spread_lt_2pp, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE win_margin<=0.001) AS n_winmargin_le_0_1pp, MIN(spread), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY spread) AS median_spread, MAX(spread) AS max_spread FROM groups; SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE column_name ILIKE '%fold%' OR column_name ILIKE '%window%' OR column_name ILIKE '%signif%' OR column_name ILIKE '%variab%' OR column_name ILIKE '%stderr%' OR column_name ILIKE '%confidence%') AS sampling_cols FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='provenance' AND table_name='forecast_metrics';
raw.observed: 40 groups: 23/40 (57.5%) spread<2pp, 2/40 (5%) win-margin<=0.1pp; median spread 0.0168 (1.7pp), max 0.0620 (6.2pp); 0 fold/window/variability/stderr/confidence/significance columns in forecast_metrics; 41/41 predictor sources is_current=true, 0 superseded.
raw.evidence: Magnitudes (typically<2pp, some<=0.1pp) are supported by forecast_metrics, but the 'below plausible sampling variability' assertion has zero DB backing — no fold/window variance, stderr, or significance columns exist — making the sampling-variability characterization overclaimed despite the magnitudes being correct.
